architecture: Acrux ecosystem first. Vega is the proving business.
coverageLimits: Development / Square Sandbox; no Production launch qualification
Each original evidence record retains its own limits; counts from distinct suites are not combined
6.8 acquisition evidence is an unpaid-draft foundation; downstream payment and fulfillment proof belongs to 6.9 and later closures
Commerce 6.10 is an earlier foundation; canonical refund-program closure includes actual full, partial and remaining-balance Sandbox execution
6.11 is staff-assisted selling, not physical card-present terminal support
6.12 covers existing authenticated members; hosted waiver versions were nonbinding Development fixtures
Reports are current business-record projections, not historical completeness, bank settlement or accounting revenue
boundaries: Authentication is distinct from business-scoped authorization
Money, fulfillment, entitlement, booking, attendance and business policy remain separate
Square owns provider transaction status; Acrux business records own authorization, purchases, fulfillment, entitlements and refund policy/disposition
Member and reporting views are projections, not new transaction authorities
Generic contracts are reusable; Vega configuration and Development-specific offer/account bindings do not imply universal onboarding
verificationBasis: Existing individual closure evidence and explicit user approval; no new transaction, regression rerun or scope expansion

capabilities.description: Server-owned offers and frozen purchase terms preserve buyer, participant and staff actor distinctions.
Provider-neutral attempts and Square Sandbox confirmation separate pending, failed and unresolved outcomes from confirmed payment.
Confirmed payment precedes exactly-once class-pack issuance; paid-but-unfulfilled outcomes retain recovery paths.
Full, whole-credit partial and successive refunds preserve original sales and separate provider outcomes from business entitlement disposition.
Authorized staff sell one eligible class pack to an existing customer without impersonation or creating attendance/bookings.
Existing members edit permitted profile fields, accept versioned waivers and see business-owned passes, bookings, purchases and refunds.
Owner/Admin, Manager, Front Desk and Instructor use explicit business-scoped permissions; refund authority is an explicit permission.
One customer workspace composes existing profile, status, booking, attendance and sale workflows with role-aware actions.
Read-only class, capacity, attendance, cancellation, waitlist and trend projections distinguish missing data from zero.
Confirmed sales, completed refunds and net transaction activity by period, offer and recorded channel; exceptions remain visible.
